title: Shepherdhood of God
definition: The shepherdhood of God means that God leads, feeds, protects, restores, corrects, and cares for His people as their Shepherd.
summary: God shepherds His people with care, guidance, protection, and restoration.
christFocus: Jesus is the Good Shepherd who lays down His life for the sheep.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Scripture often describes God as Shepherd. He guides His people, provides for them, restores their souls, protects them in danger, and leads them in righteousness.

Human shepherds can fail, but the Lord does not. He seeks the wandering, strengthens the weak, and cares for His flock.

Jesus is the Good Shepherd. He knows His sheep, lays down His life for them, and keeps them securely.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people feel lost, vulnerable, or uncared for. The shepherdhood of God matters because it reveals the Lord's personal care and guidance for His people.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Follow the Shepherd's voice in Scripture. Bring weakness and wandering to Him, and trust His care even when the path leads through valleys.
